_note: Biz in a Box service kits — rendered by components/PricingKits.tsx on the homepage and in the shared page tail. Three offers laddered by business stage: starting out -> launching -> growing. Keep inclusions jargon-free and stage-relevant.
heading: brandbizkit services
subheading: Three ways to work with us — pick the one that matches where your business is right now.

kits.name: Starter Kit
kits.tagline: Turn your idea into a real brand — with everything you need to do it yourself.
features: A working session to get clear on your idea, your customers, and your first steps
Your brand look: logo direction, colors, and fonts — as easy-to-edit Canva templates
A short market report: who your customers are, what they pay, and who you're up against
AI writing prompts tuned to your brand — so ChatGPT writes like you, not like a robot
A 30-day content calendar with the post ideas already filled in
Ready-made templates for your first landing page, price list, and social posts
A simple 1-page plan for your first 90 days
kits.outcome: You know exactly what your brand is, who it's for, and what to do next — with all the templates to do it yourself.

kits.name: Launch Kit
kits.tagline: We build it and put it live — you just plug in your products and go.
features: Everything in the Starter Kit
A professional 3–5 page website — designed, built, and put live for you
Set up so customers find you on Google — and AI tools like ChatGPT can recommend you
Contact and booking forms, with every inquiry saved in one place so you never lose a lead
Looks great on phones — where most of your customers are
Connected to your social media accounts and Google Maps
30 days of support after launch — we fix, tweak, and answer questions
kits.outcome: A ready-to-launch brand with a live website that collects customers for you from day one.

kits.name: Growth Plan
kits.tagline: We keep your marketing going every month — you approve, we do the rest.
features: A monthly strategy call to plan what we post and why
12–16 branded posts per month (images + reels), written and designed for you
Blog articles with real data and research that bring customers from Google and AI search
Everything planned and scheduled in advance — you approve before it goes out
We reply to comments and messages so no customer is left waiting
A plain-English monthly report: what grew, what worked, what's next
kits.outcome: Don't have time to do your own marketing? We do it for you: consistent, on-brand visibility that turns followers into customers.
